items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: And I have a friend that's eager to, a fellow by the name of Pritchard.

ctx.x: No, I guess not in composition and harmony and all that.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. I'd like to get some more right now if I could. I often thought that if I could get a hold of someone. Well, some of these professors around here, they teach people. I want to get a hold of a real good man, you know. And I don't care if I live to be a hundred years old. I'm going to study music. That's most of my music now. I study music. I have a book on harmony. I have a book on counterpoint and form. Well, I go along with that. And I have a friend that's eager to, a fellow by the name of…
Yeah, make a little money and they can play for a dance. That's all they do.
